title: Purple Oracle with Crystal Ball
description: A purple-skinned woman with four green eyes, geometric facial tattoos, and a long braided hairstyle adorned with purple flowers rests her head on one hand while holding a crystal ball in the other. The ball displays a red planet, silhouetted figures, and text, set against a surreal mountain landscape with a large red sun, a backpacking hiker, and abstract alien-like creatures floating in the sky.
prompt: A detailed surreal illustration of a purple-skinned woman with four glowing green eyes and geometric tattoos on her face, resting her cheek on her hand while holding a transparent crystal ball in her other hand. The ball contains a red planet, silhouetted figures, and text. She has long purple braided hair decorated with flowers. In the background are snowy mountains, a large red sun, a hiking traveler, and floating abstract alien creatures and shapes. Psychedelic and mystical atmosphere with intricate line work.
